name: 404-last-request
description: A narrative puzzle game where players investigate and fix a broken web application

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: cd packages/shared && npm install && cd ../apps/web && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && node apps/server/node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test apps/server/prisma/evaluator.test.ts apps/server/prisma/scoring.test.ts apps/server/prisma/cases.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: cd packages/shared && npm run typecheck && cd ../../apps/web && npm run typecheck && cd ../server && npm run typecheck
